Carla M: quick heads up — ran the nightly recon for 2026-01-15 and found ~62 Stripe invoices that never linked to NetSuite AR. NetSuite export shows a bunch with status 'INV_MISSING_LINK'. Anyone else seeing this?

Finance Bot: Automated alert: 2026-01-15T06:12:34Z — 14 webhook deliveries to /integrations/netsuite returned 422 Unprocessable Entity. Latest error: missing required field 'external_id'.

Mike H: can you drop 2-3 example invoice ids and a snippet of the webhook payload that failed? also when did the netSuite import start rejecting these — any PRs recently?

Carla M: example invoice ids: in_1KxA0b2pQ9Y, in_1KxA3fFh4RTz, in_1KxB7Hq9Z12
Sample payload (redacted):
```
{
  "id": "in_1KxA0b2pQ9Y",
  "customer": { "id": "cus_1Jz", "email": "acct+billing@acme.com" },
  "amount_due": 120000,
  "metadata": {}
}
```
NetSuite import logs show: `ValidationError: missing external_id` — looks like metadata.net_suite_id is empty for these customers. We used to have a middleware enrichment that added that mapping.

Rahul S: thanks — this matches something I saw. Yesterday a netsuite-import change (PR #4521) tightened validation to reject invoices without external_id to prevent creating dups. The enrichment service that used to attach net_suite_id to invoice.metadata was accidentally skipped when webhook.event == "invoice.created" if the invoice status === "open". That branch was introduced in billing-worker PR #4476 (deployed 2026-01-14) to reduce duplicate enrichment runs.

Rahul S: TL;DR: enrichment task skipped for some invoice.created events, webhook payloads landed in integration without external id, netsuite import rejects them, recon flags them as INV_MISSING_LINK.

Jen L: we can re-send the failed webhooks from Stripe (Dashboard -> Developers -> Events) but first we should be sure the enrichment step will run or do a backfill. I'm leaning to backfilling so we don't rely on re-delivery order.

Mike H: agreed. Plan proposal: 1) run a dry-run of a backfill script to map missing invoices -> netSuite ids, 2) re-run the netsuite import for those invoices with an idempotency key to avoid dupes, 3) patch billing-worker to restore enrichment for invoice.created where status=open (small revert + a guard). I'll open a Jira and run the dry-run first.

Carla M: sounds good. Is the backfill safe to run? we don't want duplicate AR records.

Mike H: backfill script uses the existing customer mapping table and will only send net_suite_id if a clear 1:1 mapping exists. It also attaches an idempotency key like `backfill:in_1KxA0b2pQ9Y` so netsuite-import will skip if already applied. Dry-run command: `python scripts/backfill_netsuite_links.py --invoices in_1KxA0b2pQ9Y,in_1KxA3fFh4RTz --dry-run`

Rahul S: I'll open the PR to re-enable enrichment branch with a safer semaphore check: PROJ-789 restore-enrichment. Mike, please add a short runtime flag so we can toggle if anything else crops up.

Mike H: creating JIRA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-1023 — includes list of invoice ids and proposed backfill. I'll run the dry-run now and post results here. ETA ~45m.

Jen L: I'll monitor Stripe event re-delivery queue and the netsuite import queue. Also setting an alert if >5 invoices fail with 422 in next 6h.

Carla M: thanks team. Please ping Finance when the backfill completes so we can re-run recon. :thumbsup:

Mike H: dry-run output (summary): would map 58/62 invoices (4 missing customer mapping — manual review needed). No idempotency collisions detected. Will run actual backfill in ~20m.

Rahul S: patch created: PR #4529 (small revert + semaphore). Adding migration to log skipped_enrichment_count for audit.

Jen L: requeue of 14 failed webhooks submitted for the 58 mapped invoices after backfill. Stripe dash link: https://dashboard.stripe.com/test/events (sent).

Carla M: awesome. once backfill completes, i'll re-run recon and confirm AR creation. thx!

Mike H: backfill run complete — 58 linked, 4 flagged for manual review. Re-ran netsuite import for the 58 with idempotency keys; import response: 200 OK x58. Recon should be clean.

Carla M: confirmed — recon now shows those 58 as linked. Logged manual actions for the 4 flagged ones. Filing a short postmortem and retro action to add an integration test.

Rahul S: noted, will merge PR #4529 after CI.

Carla M: solid. thanks all :raised_hands:
